data.title: Junior Financial Data Analyst
data.fitReason: This role sits precisely at the intersection of the candidate's two skill sets. Six years of financial reporting and reconciliation work provides immediate domain credibility, while Power BI dashboards and basic SQL satisfy the technical entry bar. Most competitors for this role are pure data analysts without accounting depth, giving this candidate a structural advantage in interpreting financial data correctly. Salary range aligns well with target.

data.title: FP&A Analyst
data.fitReason: Financial Planning and Analysis roles lean heavily on Excel modeling, financial reporting knowledge, and the ability to translate numbers into business narratives — all areas where this candidate is genuinely strong. The Power BI dashboards are a direct differentiator here as FP&A teams increasingly demand visualization capability. SQL is useful but not always a hard requirement at junior level. The 6-year accounting background removes the domain learning curve that pure analysts face.

data.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
data.fitReason: Power BI dashboard delivery and basic SQL directly address the core BI analyst toolkit at junior level. The financial domain expertise is additive when working with finance or operations data. The main limitation is SQL depth — BI roles at even junior level often require moderate query complexity and data modeling awareness, which the candidate currently lacks. The 2 delivered dashboards serve as a portfolio anchor in interviews. Best fit at companies where Excel and Power BI dominate over engineering-heavy BI stacks.

data.title: Accounting and Reporting Analyst
data.fitReason: This hybrid role, increasingly common at multinationals and large Vietnamese corporations, blends traditional accounting responsibilities with data reporting and dashboard work. The candidate's 6 years of accounting experience justifies mid-level positioning here, and the Power BI and Excel skills directly answer the reporting component. This role carries lower analytics ambition than pure BI paths but offers stability, competitive pay, and a stepping stone to transition further into analytics with on-the-job tool development.

data.title: Junior Data Analyst
data.fitReason: A generalist data analyst role is accessible given the SQL and Python foundation, data analytics certificate, and Power BI deliverables. The accounting background adds domain flavor but is less differentiated in non-finance contexts. The candidate competes here against recent graduates who may have stronger SQL and Python portfolios, so targeting finance-adjacent companies or sectors where financial literacy is valued would sharpen competitiveness. The fit is real but requires a stronger SQL portfolio to sustain beyond resume screening.

data.title: Management Reporting Specialist
data.fitReason: This role focuses on producing recurring management reports, KPI dashboards, and financial summaries for senior leadership — a workflow the candidate has effectively been practising in accounting. Advanced Excel, Power BI, and 6 years of financial reporting experience make this a natural fit. It may not carry the analytics career trajectory the candidate wants long-term, but it is highly achievable now, salary-competitive within target range, and commonly available at banks, insurance companies, and large corporates in Hanoi.

data.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
data.fitReason: Revenue operations roles at tech or SaaS companies in Hanoi require financial modeling, data reporting, and CRM data interpretation — areas where the candidate's Excel strength and financial background are directly relevant. Power BI and basic SQL cover the reporting layer. The gap is in CRM tool familiarity (Salesforce, HubSpot) and business process knowledge outside pure accounting. Demand is growing as more international tech firms set up Vietnam operations, but role availability is more limited than traditional finance analytics positions.

data.title: Finance Operations Analyst
data.fitReason: Finance operations roles blend process management with data analysis in areas like accounts payable, treasury reporting, and cost control — all within the candidate's accounting experience base. The data analytics upskilling makes this candidate more capable than a pure accountant applicant. The role is less analytically forward-looking than FP&A or BI paths but is broadly available across Hanoi's banking, manufacturing, and services sectors. Good as a parallel application target while analytics skills continue to build.

data.title: Junior Data Reporting Analyst
data.fitReason: Data reporting roles focused on dashboards, automated reports, and data visualization are a close match for the current Power BI and Excel skill set. These roles typically require less complex SQL and no Python, lowering the technical bar relative to full analyst roles. The risk is that this role type can be narrow in scope and may not provide the varied analytics experience needed to progress. Best pursued at companies with structured analytics teams where growth pathways exist beyond pure reporting.

data.title: Junior Business Analyst
data.fitReason: Business analyst roles in Hanoi frequently recruit from accounting and finance backgrounds due to the need to document financial processes, analyze operational data, and bridge communication between business units and technical teams. The candidate's financial domain knowledge and Excel proficiency satisfy common BA requirements. SQL and Power BI are bonuses rather than requirements at junior level. The fit is real but less precise than finance-specific analytics roles — the candidate would need to emphasize stakeholder communication and process documentation experience which may be limited from a pure accounting background.
